purpose: External reproduction panel for frozen V7 (docs/EXTERNAL_V7_REPRODUCTION_PROTOCOL.md). The physical parameter points are Result 40 cells; the disorder seeds are NEW and reserved for the outside run. No (cell, seed) combination below has been simulated by the authors.
selection_rule: for each (support class, routed branch) in {B,C,D} x {v4,v6}, the Result 40 cell with the lowest ID; seeds 400-405 assigned in that order
initial_state: cavity vacuum x all emitters excited
disorder: w_i = omega_c + numpy.random.default_rng(seed).normal(0.0, sigma, M) -- the call in pv7/engine/exact_tc.py draw_disorder. NumPy does not formally guarantee identical Generator streams across versions; run_selfcheck.py verifies the draw for a published seed bit for bit before any panel cell is run, and the runner records every drawn array.

cells.note: internal worst case in Result 40 (selected by the ID rule, not by performance)
